Sasha: heads-up — seeing a regression in host-side p95 for streaming requests on small-frame workloads. p95 is +40ms after the kernel-picker rollout earlier this morning.

Raj: any traces yet? which ingress path is worse — http2 or grpc?

Sasha: mostly HTTP/2. Repro locally with: `wrk -t8 -c200 --script smallframes.lua http2://ingress:443/stream`. Logs show a lot of tiny frames (<=64B) and extra SETTINGS/HEADERS churn. KV cache eviction rate spikes line up with the latency bursts.

Elaine: that rings a bell — we recently changed the preparse chunker to emit smaller fragments for stream pacing. If chunker reports many tiny fragments, kernel selector currently picks the throughput-optimized kernel A. For tiny frames we should prefer the low-latency kernel B. I suspect the selector histogram bins are misaligned with the new fragment sizes.

Mike: confirmed on a host: `perf top` shows hot stacks in `http2::parse_settings` and `tokenizer::writev_fanout`. Also saw `kvcache::evict` activity spike. KV hit rate dropped badly during the window.

Sasha: dumped kvcache counters during a spike: `kvcache.hits=17%`, `kvcache.misses=83%` (30s window). If we coalesce upstream small frames to fewer writes we see kvcache churn go down.

Raj: quick hypothesis — chunker sets `frag_hint=1` to signal micro-fragments and that path bypasses the prefetch/pipeline that primes KV keys. Kernel selector then thinks sequence lengths are tiny and chooses slow-path kernel causing extra memcopy and TLS/syscall overhead. Proposed: change kernel-selection threshold for streaming workloads from `128 -> 64` and re-enable prefetch for frag_hint <= 1.

Elaine: sounds plausible. Can you run `./bin/trace_ingress --pid <proxy_pid> --mode frames --duration 30s` and capture frame size distribution + kvcache events?

Sasha: running now. Also pushed a canary branch `hot/stream-smallframe-opt` with the selector tweak and prefetch toggle. CI:

ci-bot: ci/build 1234 passed :white_check_mark: https://ci.internal/1234

Raj: :eyes: after canary is up I'll run an ablation where we explicitly disable kvcache prefetch to confirm causality.

Mike: if this holds we should (1) backport smallframe kernel hinting, (2) add a telemetry gauge for frag_size_hist and selector_decision, and (3) update Optimize to suggest coalescing for HTTP/2 small-frame clients.

Sasha: thanks — will post perf flamegraphs + kvcache snapshot in #eng-runtime once trace completes. If anyone wants early access to the canary endpoint ping me.
